playerLine: I hold out the ledger and ask Brannoch to read the last page.
narration: Brannoch takes the ledger in both hands and tilts it to the window. His lips move for a moment. "Eleven crates, no names, and a mark I do not like," he says, and the paper trembles very slightly. He turns the book so you can see a small circle drawn in red, crossed twice.

characterContext.playerSummary: A ferry-hand with a borrowed name.
